capabilities: edit variable fields in a varpad fenced code block
render snippet outputs live from templates
copy rendered snippet outputs to the clipboard
save entered values back into the note
color-code where each variable appears in snippets
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states the YAML is parsed as data and embedded JavaScript is not evaluated; the first version omits the standalone VarPad app's workspace manager and themes.
motivation: "Some command sequences are too irregular to script but too frequent to retype."
problem: Repeated command sequences that only differ in a few values are hard to script but tedious and error-prone to retype or patch by hand from history.

relations.evidence: Live Note Parameters — the closest match. You select {{NAME}} references in commands

summary: Note-local variable pad that renders template snippets from a varpad code block and lets you copy the filled-in results.
